meta.description: Ottawa diner at 1385 Wellington Street West. Breakfast all day. Tables by phone: (613) 798-7800.

nav.strip: Hintonburg · breakfast all day · call for a table

callbar.line: Reservations are taken by phone. We do not book tables on this site.

home.title: Your neighborhood diner.
home.lead: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and the in-between. They print: come in, sit down, get ready to eat.
home.heroAlt: A Wellington Diner burger and fries.
home.hoursLead: As printed on their home page. Their schema lists the same window but skips Monday — we print the seven-day board they show.
home.menuLead: Benny, hashes, milkshakes, weekly specials. Prices from their live menu. Tax extra. Prices may change.
home.challengeLead: 40 minutes or it's $49.99. Oreo shake, three Mac Daddy burgers, double homie poutine. No splitting, no take-home.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Served daily. Breakfast all day. A slice of their priced board — not every extra and modifier.
menu.note: Prices exclude tax and may change. In-house specials have their own rules.

specials.title: Specials
specials.lead: As printed on their menu. In-house only where they say so.
specials.challengeCaption: They credit Beard Meets Food for making it famous.

hours.title: Hours
hours.lead: Come visit us — daily 8 am to 9 pm on the home page.
hours.schema: Their Google schema also says 08:00–21:00, but it lists Sunday and Tuesday–Saturday only (no Monday). We do not drop Monday when the page itself prints it.
hours.delivery: Third-party apps sometimes show different close times. We print the diner’s own hours.

about.title: About
about.lead: The Wellington Diner is a traditional diner in Ottawa. Family since 2015. Fresh ingredients, casual, family-friendly — as they write it.
about.blend: They write a blend of locally-sourced products and classic dishes.
about.address: 1385 Wellington Street West, Ottawa, ON K1Y 2X1 — as their schema prints. Some maps use K1Y 2X2. We use the postal they publish.
about.challenge: The Mac Daddy challenge lives on its own page on their site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Reservations are taken by phone. Please call to book. Their Wix form is for messages, not a table hold. We do not process reservations here.
contact.delivery: The live site mentions DoorDash. We do not invent a store URL.

footer.copy: Preview of wellingtondiner.com. Live Wix site stays until they say otherwise.
